title: Missing Receipt Evidence
description: Invoice and dispatch records record 100 pcs dispatched under shipment SHP-004. However, no signed proof of delivery or receipt record exists in the supplied dataset.

dispute.message: Buyer claims goods were never delivered for invoice INV-004. No delivery acknowledgment found.

expected_findings.statement: No signed proof-of-delivery or receipt record found in supplied dataset for shipment SHP-004.
assumptions: Dispatch record DSPT-REC-004 confirms carrier handover on 2026-10-16.
limitations: Absence in this dataset does not prove physical delivery failed or that no receipt exists elsewhere.
expected_findings.next_step: Request courier consignment tracking or physical gate-entry receipt from buyer warehouse.

unresolved_questions: Was the consignment delivered and signed for by personnel outside the recorded system?
Is delivery currently in transit with logistics carrier?
